zh: 任意两个数的公共前缀，一定是第一个数的某个前缀，也一定是第二个数的某个前缀；所以只要把一边所有数的所有前缀都准备好，就能逐个检查另一边的前缀。
把 arr1 中每个数的十进制字符串的所有非空前缀放进集合。再扫描 arr2 中每个数的前缀，从短到长检查是否在集合中，命中就更新最大长度，一旦不命中就可以停止，因为更长的前缀也不可能命中。
把 arr1 每个数转成字符串，依次把长度为 1 到全长的前缀加入集合；答案初始为 0；对 arr2 每个数的字符串，按长度 1、2、… 取前缀，不在集合中就跳出，否则用当前长度更新答案；输出答案。
en: The common prefix of any two numbers is a prefix of the first and also a prefix of the second. So if you prepare every prefix of every number on one side, you can check the prefixes of the other side one by one.

Put every non-empty prefix of the decimal string of each number in arr1 into a set. Then scan the prefixes of each number in arr2 from short to long: each hit updates the maximum length, and the first miss lets you stop, since longer prefixes cannot hit either.

Convert each number in arr1 to a string and add its prefixes of lengths 1 through full length to a set. Start the answer at 0. For each number in arr2, take prefixes of length 1, 2, ...; stop at the first prefix not in the set, otherwise update the answer with the current length. Print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Put all non-empty prefixes of the decimal representation of every number in arr1 into a set. Then scan the prefixes of each number in arr2; every prefix found in the set updates the maximum length, and after the first miss there is no need to keep scanning that number.

## Proof of correctness

For any number x in arr1 and number y in arr2, the common prefix of x and y is necessarily a prefix of x, so it has been added to the set; when y is scanned, this common prefix hits the set. Conversely, if some prefix of y hits the set, it is a prefix of some number in arr1 and also a prefix of y, so it corresponds to a valid pair. The algorithm checks all possible prefixes and takes the maximum length, so it obtains the longest common prefix over all cross-array pairs.

## Complexity

Let D be the total number of digits of all numbers in both arrays. Building and querying the set takes O(D) expected time, with O(D) extra space.
